exposure: Type of polymeric formula (taste vs tasteless, isocaloric vs hypercaloric)
Route of exclusive enteral nutrition (EEN) delivery (oral vs nasogastric tube)
cohort: 92 pediatric patients with Crohn's disease treated with EEN
finding: The study found no significant effect of the route of EEN delivery or the type of polymeric formula used on treatment outcomes in pediatric patients with Crohn's disease.
